pr_body:
First, a bugfix - assigning to `evaluator.ctx` in `eval()` broke the parent-child relationship.
Pass the `Context` down through function calls instead.

Then, for aggregates, operators, calls, show what operation is performed.
Add a method `ShortString()` to keep the changes together with other AST printing code.

Also add a span when series are expanded, typically time spent accessing TSDB.
`MatrixSelector` nodes typically don't reach `eval()`, so this way they are covered.

Fixes #12099

issue_context.title: PromQL Tracing spans could be more helpful
issue_context.body:
### Proposal

This is an example of what I see in my tracing view:

```
promqlInnerEval (10.22s)
 promqlInnerEval eval *parser.Call (10.22s)
  promqlInnerEval eval *parser.StepInvariantExpr (106μs)
   promqlInnerEval eval *parser.BinaryExpr (67μs)
    promqlInnerEval eval *parser.BinaryExpr (58μs)
     promqlInnerEval eval *parser.NumberLiteral (3μs)
      promqlInnerEval eval *parser.NumberLiteral (2μs)
       promqlInnerEval eval *parser.NumberLiteral (1μs)
```

None of the spans have any more explanation.  Outside of this view, I happen to know the query is:

```
predict_linear(node_filesystem_files_free{fstype!="",mountpoint!=""}[6h], 4*60*60)
```

So, wouldn't it be nicer to see something like this?

```
promqlInnerEval (10.22s)
 promql call predict_linear (10.22s)
  promql StepInvariantExpr (106μs)
   promql eval BinaryExpr * (67μs)
    promql eval BinaryExpr * (58μs)
     promql NumberLiteral 4 (3μs)
      promql NumberLiteral 60 (2μs)
       promql NumberLiteral 60 (1μs)
```
comments: I think that the action names should not be unbounded as they are shown in dropdowns, e.g. in jaeger. It would be difficult to select e.g. all function calls.
Fair point.  If the information was available in attributes then Grafana (at least) has a way to bring them out to the top-level display.

review_comments: Should  we check if span != nil ?
I read the documentation and the implementation and decided it was designed not to need the check.
